text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in the opening sentence","quality":"clear position","description":"The essay states its stance immediately and keeps that position explicit throughout."},{"evidence":"three separate body paragraphs on fuel, safety, and convenience","quality":"organized structure","description":"The argument is broken into distinct points that make the essay easier to follow."},{"evidence":"references to Sergey Brin, sensors, GM seats, Tesla, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, and Nissan","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses multiple details from the article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"explains half the fuel and less CO2","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay does more than quote the source by explaining why the fuel claim matters."},{"evidence":"links sensor advances to better response and control than a human","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay connects evidence to its claims in a more developed way instead of just listing facts."},{"evidence":"final paragraph returns to all three benefits and restates the thesis","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending summarizes the main reasons and gives the argument a sense of closure."}]}
